Priya K: Hey team — finalizing the RFC review roster for Thu. We have 5 authors but only 3 main reviewer slots. Can folks confirm availability and whether they can swap slots? Pre-reads are here: https://redwood/s/rfcs/review-deck (please ack)

Ben L: I can pick up an extra review slot after 10:30 PT if needed.

Jordan M: I was penciled in for the 10:00 slot but can move to 11:00. @Priya K which RFCs are flexible?

Priya K: Flexible are #3 (kv-cache perf) and #5 (batching heuristics). Want to keep #1 (routing/fallback) first since it's infra-critical. Proposed order (rough):
```
09:30-09:40 #1 routing/fallback (author + 10m review + 5m Q&A)
09:40-09:55 #2 compilation/kernel selection (author + 10m review + 5m Q&A)
09:55-10:20 #3 kv-cache perf (longer, author + 15m review + 5m Q&A)
10:20-10:35 #4 deployment abstraction (author + 10m review + 5m Q&A)
10:35-10:50 #5 batching heuristics (author + 10m review + 5m Q&A)
```
(we can compress if we do lightning Q&A)

Elaine: I can review #5 and will do the pre-read by EOD today. +1 to moving #3 earlier.

calendar-bot: Event created: "RFC Reviews — Thu" • Thu Feb 11 2026 09:30 PT — invites sent.

Priya K: Ok locking in provisional order. @Jordan M please confirm 11:00 is fine if we need to push someone later. Also tagging reviewers: @Ben L @Elaine can you both prepare a 3-bullet review note for your assigned RFCs? I'll ping authors for 1-slide summaries.

Ben L: Yep — will add a short summary + two risks to the doc.

Jordan M: Confirmed — 11:00 is fine if we need it. Quick ask: can we do a 5-min lightning Q&A per talk to keep momentum? Might need to drop one non-blocking RFC if we run over.

Priya K: Good idea. Updated agenda to explicitly include 5-min Q&A and a 5-min buffer at the end for follow-ups. Final agenda: 
```
09:30-09:40 #1 routing/fallback (author) + 10m review + 5m Q&A
09:40-09:50 #2 compilation/kernel selection (author) + 10m review + 5m Q&A
09:50-10:05 #3 kv-cache perf (author) + 15m review + 5m Q&A
10:05-10:15 #4 deployment abstraction (author) + 10m review + 5m Q&A
10:15-10:25 #5 batching heuristics (author) + 10m review + 5m Q&A
10:25-10:30 buffer/next steps
```
I'll send a reminder tomorrow morning with final slots and links. If anyone needs to swap last-minute, reply here and I'll update the calendar. :thumbsup:
